title: VTDiag KB error code
description: kb/codes/*.json: VAN/VAL codes with per-cause strength (logged > typed) and route verdicts.

id.description: Stable id, for example van-9003, val-group-account.

codes.description: Canonical normalized codes this row covers (VAN 9003; groups like VAL 31, VAL 43...). Normalization (A2): upper-case invariant, "VAN9003", "van-9003", "VAN: 9003" all become VAN 9003.

category.description: Category from the research data (for example vanguard_requirement, ban, val_account).

meaningKey.description: String key of the official meaning.

route.description: Route verdict; when set, ranking short-circuits and no fix is offered.

logged.description: Log-odds when the code was found in logs or crash reports.

typed.description: Log-odds when the code was only typed by the player (must be at most Logged).

items.description: A cause an error code points at.

pointsTo.description: Causes this code points at, each with its own strength.

officialUrls.description: Official Riot support URLs (shown, never auto-opened from plans).

askIfTyped.description: Question to ask when the code was only typed (for example "does another account work on this PC?").

item.description: One row of the error-code table (from research/error_codes.json, 57 codes). Codes go through this table with a per-cause strength; codes found in logs weigh more than codes the player typed (typos, mis-copies); a route code short-circuits (VAN 152 to appeal, console/VM/Mac out of scope, VAL 43/57/59 "try another account"). File: kb/codes/*.json. Schema: kb/schema/code.schema.json.
